services.title: One operator for the whole journey.
services.sub: Fifteen services, from the first market study to the warranty desk. Use one or all. Fixed fees up front; once you sell through us, we earn on what sells.

groups.name: Enter the market
groups.intro: Know the market, get there, and get legal — before the first container.

groups.name: Sell and grow
groups.intro: Put the product on real shelves and marketplaces, then build the brand that keeps it there.

groups.name: Run it
groups.intro: The systems, freight and after-sales that make the tenth shipment as smooth as the first.

labels.indicative: Timelines are typical ranges; your market lead confirms them for your product.

items.name: Research & development
items.one: Market and product research that tells you what will sell, at what price, before you ship a single unit.
items.problem: Most factories pick a market from a spreadsheet. The real answer is on the shop counter — what is stocked, what it costs, and what the shopkeeper will not touch.
deliverables: Shelf and price survey in the target cities
Competitor range and pricing map
Product fit and spec changes for the market
Go / no-go report with a recommended entry route

items.name: Market survey trips
items.one: We take your team on the ground to see the market first-hand — shops, distributors, warehouses and regulators.
items.problem: Decisions made from a desk in Shenzhen miss what a day in the local market shows in an hour: who really sets the price, and who you can trust.
deliverables: Planned itinerary with retail clusters and distributor meetings
Introductions to vetted distributors and partners
Certification and customs briefing on the ground
Written debrief and next-step plan

items.name: Travel & ground support
items.one: Visas, hotels, pick and drop, interpreters and a planner — for groups, individuals and business owners.
items.problem: A first trip to a new market loses days to visas, transport and translation. We remove that friction so the time goes to meetings.
deliverables: Visa invitation letters and guidance
Hotels and in-country transport, including airport pick and drop
Interpreters for Urdu, Hindi, Filipino, Arabic and Mandarin
A trip planner on call for the whole visit

items.name: Company registration & set-up
items.one: A local company, bank account and office set up properly, so you can trade in your own name.
items.problem: Without a local entity you depend on someone else's licence. Setting one up from abroad is slow and easy to get wrong.
deliverables: Entity choice and structure advice
Registration, tax numbers and import licences
Bank account and local office set-up
Nominee and compliance support for the first year

items.name: Customs & taxation
items.one: Duties, sales tax and import paperwork handled, with a landed cost you can price from.
items.problem: Duty structures change with budgets, and a mis-declared HS code can strand a container for weeks. Margin disappears in the paperwork.
deliverables: HS classification and duty planning
Sales tax / VAT / GST registration and filings
Import licences and clearance documents
Monthly compliance check as rules change

items.name: Certification & compliance
items.one: Product approvals filed and carried by us, run in parallel rather than in sequence.
items.problem: In many markets product registration is mandatory and slow; without it there is no market at all. Every market has its own clock, and most brands start it too late.
deliverables: Certification map for your product and markets
Lab testing and document preparation
Filing and follow-up with the regulator
Renewals and change-of-model updates

items.name: Distribution & sales
items.one: The real channel: modern trade where it exists, and the ten-thousand-shop informal trade where it does not.
items.problem: A warehouse is not distribution. Products sell when dealers stock them, shopkeepers recommend them and someone visits again next month.
deliverables: Dealer and distributor network in each city
Pricing, margins and credit terms by channel
Field sales team and shop visits
Monthly sell-through and stock reports

items.name: Marketplaces
items.one: Your range live and selling on Daraz, Flipkart, Amazon.in, Lazada, Shopee, Noon and Amazon.ae.
items.problem: Each marketplace has its own listing rules, fulfilment model and ad system. Account health, reviews and ad spend need daily attention.
deliverables: Store set-up and listings in local languages
Fulfilment set-up (FBA, FBN, Daraz/Lazada warehouses)
Ads, promotions and review management
Weekly performance reporting

items.name: Brand building
items.one: Naming, packaging, price architecture and warranty terms — a brand built for the shelf it sells from.
items.problem: Factories that make well often market badly. In these markets the box, the price point and the warranty card do most of the selling.
deliverables: Positioning, name and identity
Packaging and warranty card system
Price architecture by channel
Retail training pack and launch materials

items.name: Brand scaling & growth
items.one: Growth plans that add markets, channels and range once the first market works.
items.problem: The first market proves the product. Growing beyond it means new channels, new SKUs and a team that can run without the founder in every decision.
deliverables: Quarterly growth plan with targets
New channel and new market roll-out
Range extension and pricing reviews
Performance creative and promotions

items.name: Senior brand operator
items.one: A senior operator from TGO runs your brand in a market as its head — part-time, with full accountability.
items.problem: Hiring a country head before the market works is expensive and risky. You need someone senior who already knows the market, from day one.
deliverables: A named TGO operator as head of brand for the market
Weekly operating reviews with your team
Ownership of the P&L plan, channel and team
Hand-over to a local hire when you are ready

items.name: IT solutions
items.one: Design, software, cloud, data, AI and security from one team — from a launch website to the systems a whole distribution business runs on.
items.problem: A new market needs new systems all at once: a site in the local language, a shop that takes local payments, devices, data and security. Bought from five vendors, they rarely work together.
deliverables: One technical lead for every project
Written scope, fixed price or a monthly retainer
Security and backups set up from day one
Documentation and handover, so you own every system

catalog.title: Nine practices, one team.
catalog.sub: Use one practice or several. Tools are chosen for your market and budget, not for a vendor.

groups.d: Decide what to build, buy or keep before the money is spent.
items: IT audits and technical due diligence

groups.d: Screens people understand on first use, in every language you sell in.
Websites, apps and platforms built to load fast and last for years.
items: Web apps, customer portals and dashboards

groups.d: Sell online and keep every system in step with the others.
items: Online stores on Shopify, WooCommerce or a custom stack
Local payment gateways, wallets and cash on delivery
Analytics, conversion tracking and technical SEO

groups.d: Turn the data you already hold into decisions and saved hours.
items: Data pipelines, reporting and BI dashboards
AI assistants for web and WhatsApp, with hand-off to a person
Search and answers across your own documents
Demand forecasting and visual quality inspection

groups.d: For hardware brands: the app and the cloud behind the device.
Hosting, deployment and office IT that stay up and stay affordable.
items: Cloud set-up and migration: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud
CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code
Monitoring, uptime and cloud cost control
Office networks, devices, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace

groups.d: Built in from the first day, not added after a breach.
items: Endpoint protection, backups and disaster recovery

groups.d: Support after launch, or engineers who work inside your team.

items.name: ERP & CRM SaaS integration
items.one: Inventory, orders, dealers and customers in one connected system — for manufacturers and distributors.
items.problem: Stock in one spreadsheet, dealers in another and orders on WhatsApp. Growth breaks it; you cannot manage what you cannot see.
deliverables: System choice (Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot and others)
Set-up for inventory, orders, dealers and invoicing
Integration with marketplaces, accounting and WhatsApp
Team training and ongoing support

items.name: Logistics & landed cost
items.one: Freight from China to the shelf, LCL or FCL, with a true landed cost per unit before you commit.
items.problem: Freight, duty, clearance and last-mile costs are where trial shipments lose their margin — usually discovered after the fact.
deliverables: Landed-cost model per SKU and market
Consolidated LCL and FCL shipping
Clearance, warehousing and last-mile delivery
Shipment tracking and cost reports

items.name: Warranty & after-sales
items.one: Local replacement, repairs and spares — so the brand honours its warranty and is remembered for it.
items.problem: Warranty culture is thin in these markets, which is exactly why a brand that honours it wins. Without local service, returns pile up with the dealer.
deliverables: Warranty terms and claim process
Local replacement and repair partners
Spares stock and return logistics
Defect reporting back to the factory
